lines.japanese: 「えっ？　あれ？　千歳……くん？」
lines.english: “Huh? Wait. Chitose...?”
“Hm?”

lines.japanese: 自動改札を出たところで、女が俺に声をかけてきた。
lines.english: A woman called out to me just beyond the automatic ticket gate.

lines.japanese: 「千歳君……え？　あれ？　ですよね？」
lines.english: “Chitose...? Wait, what? It is you, isn't it?”

lines.japanese: そこにいたのは米田優。亀のように首を前へ伸ばして俺をうかがっている。
lines.english: There stood Yu Yoneda, craning her neck toward me like a turtle as she peered into my face.

lines.japanese: ちょうどいい。試験運用も次の段階だ、そろそろ対人交流テストを行いたいと思っていたところだ。
lines.english: Excellent timing. Our trial run had entered its next stage, and I had just been thinking it was time for an interpersonal communication test.

lines.japanese: 「やあ、米田さんのひとじゃないですか。どうしました、そんな、初めて実物の時計台を目の当たりにしたときのような面持ちで。ええ、もちろん俺は、千歳鷲介的な一面をも併せもつ偉大な存在に違いありませんよ」
lines.english: “Well, if it isn't Miss Yoneda herself. What's with the face? You look like someone seeing a real live clock tower for the first time. And yes, naturally, I am a magnificent being who contains a Shusuke Chitose side as well.”
“What?”

lines.japanese: む、しまった、眉根を寄せられてしまった。まずいな、可能なかぎり鷲介に似せたつもりだったが、微妙に暑苦しさが足りなかったかもしれない。
lines.english: Hm. A mistake. Her brow had furrowed. This was bad. I had tried to sound as much like Shusuke as possible, but perhaps I was a shade short on oppressively exuberant intensity.

lines.japanese: 「え、なんか……ていうか、どうしたの声……」
lines.english: “Um... What's going on? And what happened to your voice...?”

lines.japanese: 「ああ、そうか、声が違うからか。ええと、コレはほら風邪ですよ。そう、グレタガルド風邪。まだこの国ではマイナーですが、一般的な流行性感冒より喉に来るのですね。ぐれっす、ぐれっす」
lines.english: “Ah, of course. The voice is different. This is, er... a cold. Yes, Gretagard flu. It's still uncommon in this country, but it hits the throat harder than ordinary influenza. Gret-ss, gret-ss.”

lines.japanese: 「そ、そう、お大事に……」
lines.english: “R-right. Take care of yourself...”

lines.japanese: 米田優はてのひらで口に蓋をしながら、迷惑そうに一歩引いて言った。
lines.english: Yu Yoneda covered her mouth with one hand and took a wary step backward.

lines.japanese: 「で、そのカッコはなんなの。朝っぱらから学生服なんか着ちゃって……」
lines.english: “And what's with that outfit? Wearing a school uniform first thing in the morning...”

lines.japanese: 「ああ、これですか。ふふふ、気になっていますね？　一説によれば、学生時代に異性との交流が少なかった者ほど、いくつ歳を重ねても制服に夢を持ちつづける、つまり制服フェチになると言いますがさてさて」
lines.english: “Ah, this? Heh heh. It has caught your interest, has it? Some say the less contact one had with the opposite sex in school, the longer one continues to dream of uniforms with age—in other words, the more likely one is to develop a school-uniform fetish. Now, then...”

lines.japanese: 「いや、やっぱりなんか……」
lines.english: “No, there's definitely something...”

lines.japanese: 「ていうか、なんなの本当、そのカッコ。まさか千歳君、ひょっとしてまだ学生だったとか言わないよね」
lines.english: “Seriously, what is that outfit? Chitose, don't tell me you're still a student.”

lines.japanese: 「ううむ、言うべきか言わざるべきか」
lines.english: “Hmm. To tell, or not to tell.”

lines.japanese: 「えっ、ほんとに学生なの！」
lines.english: “Wait, you really are a student!?”

lines.japanese: 「ときどき」
lines.english: “Sometimes.”

lines.japanese: 「定時制？」
lines.english: “Night school?”

lines.japanese: 「違いますね。まあ、詳しく話せば長くなるのです。お時間よろしいですか、小八時間ほど」
lines.english: “No. The full explanation would take rather a while. Do you have, say, eight hours to spare?”

lines.japanese: 「社会人なめてんのか。ダイジェストでお送りしてよ」
lines.english: “Do you have any idea how busy working people are? Give me the highlights.”

lines.japanese: 「残念ですが俺の人生はすべてがクライマックスなので、切りおとすところなんてありません」
lines.english: “Regrettably, my life is one long climax. There isn't a single second you can cut.”

lines.japanese: 「それは送り手の傲慢だよ。受け手を無視した作品ていうのは、文章でも映像でも──」
lines.english: “That's the arrogance of the creator. Any work that ignores its audience, whether written or filmed—”

lines.japanese: 「──あ、そうか分かった。千歳君、今からエキストラのバイトでしょ。ドラマのロケ、学生服持参で」
lines.english: “—oh, I know! Chitose, you're headed to a job as an extra, aren't you? A television shoot, and you had to bring your own uniform.”

lines.japanese: 「おお、ナイス言い訳。それいただきましょう」
lines.english: “Oh, excellent excuse. I'll be taking that.”

lines.japanese: 「いや、でも、いただけないね。そういうのは現地の更衣室で着替えなきゃ駄目だよ」
lines.english: “No, you can't take it. You're supposed to change in the dressing room at the location.”

lines.japanese: 「はあ。そうなのですか」
lines.english: “Oh. Is that how it works?”

lines.japanese: 「イベントでもいるんだよねえ。制服系とかスポーツ系だと、これは私服だからとか言って、コスプレ来場しちゃうマナーの悪いレイヤー」
lines.english: “You see people do it at conventions too. With school uniforms or athletic outfits, they claim it's just regular clothing and show up already in cosplay. Terrible manners.”

lines.japanese: 「は？　なんの話です？」
lines.english: “What? What are you talking about?”

lines.japanese: 「ああいや、なんでもない、こっちの話──」
lines.english: “Oh, nothing. Just something of mine—”

lines.japanese: 「──あっ！　い、言っとくけど私、現役じゃないからね！」
lines.english: “—wait! J-just so we're clear, I'm not active anymore!”

lines.japanese: むかし一時期だけとか、同人やってる友達に頼まれてとか、米田優は聞いてもいないことを勝手に喋って勝手に言葉を濁らせていった。
lines.english: It had only been a brief phase, she said. A friend in the amateur publishing scene had asked her to do it. Yu Yoneda offered these explanations without being asked, then let her voice trail off.

lines.japanese: 「はあ。米田さんのひとも青春時代は若気が至りまくっていたのですな」
lines.english: “I see. So Miss Yoneda spent her youth giving free rein to youthful indiscretion.”

lines.japanese: 「私のことはいいの。いまは君の話を──」
lines.english: “Forget about me. We're talking about you—”

lines.japanese: 「俺のこともいいです。いまは米田優の話を」
lines.english: “We can forget about me too. Let us discuss Yu Yoneda.”

lines.japanese: 「だめ、そっちの話」
lines.english: “No. The other subject.”

lines.japanese: 「いえいえ、米田優の話を」
lines.english: “Please, I insist. Yu Yoneda.”

lines.japanese: 俺と米田優は、慌ただしい朝の改札前でしばし火花を散らせた。
lines.english: Yu Yoneda and I locked horns for a time before the ticket gates amid the morning rush.

lines.japanese: しかしすぐに彼女が和平を持ちかけてきた。
lines.english: Before long, however, she offered terms of peace.

lines.japanese: 「分かった。お互い触れられたくない部分はあるということで」
lines.english: “All right. Let's agree that we both have things we'd rather not discuss.”

lines.japanese: 「同感です。それでは」
lines.english: “Agreed. Farewell, then.”

lines.japanese: そして俺たちは互いに背を向け、おのおの東西へ別れていった。
lines.english: And so we turned our backs on one another and went our separate ways, east and west.

lines.japanese: 「ふふん、米田さんめ、新しく生まれかわったブランニュー俺に一分の疑念も抱いていなかったな」
lines.english: “Hmph. That Yoneda woman never suspected my new-and-improved, freshly reborn self for a second.”

lines.japanese: 対人テストもまずまず順調のようだ。
lines.english: The interpersonal test appeared to be proceeding reasonably well.

lines.japanese: 学校に着いたが、しかし教室へ向かう前に、ロビーの壁へ寄って背中を預けた。
lines.english: I reached school, but before going to the classroom, I leaned my back against the lobby wall.

lines.japanese: 腕を組み、片足を投げだしてリラックス態勢。
lines.english: Arms folded, one leg stretched out: full relaxation mode.

lines.japanese: 「ふぅ……さっきみたいに不意をうって話しかけられると、いくら冷静沈着で知られる俺もほんのちょっぴり焦っちゃうからな」
lines.english: “Whew... When somebody catches me off guard like that, even I—renowned for my perfect calm—can get the tiniest bit flustered.”

lines.japanese: いつ誰に遭遇しても最適な対応を為せるよう、いまのうち可能なかぎり心の準備をしておこう。
lines.english: I would prepare myself as thoroughly as possible now, so that I could respond perfectly to whomever I might encounter.

lines.japanese: というわけで、俺はいまの自分──美空学園三年Ａ組・羽田鷹志としての状況を整理した。
lines.english: Accordingly, I reviewed my present circumstances as Takashi Haneda, a third-year in Class A at Misora Academy.

lines.japanese: きのうのタカシの学園生活を思いかえす。
lines.english: I retraced Takashi's school day yesterday.

lines.japanese: タカシは──俺は、まず朝の通学路の途上で、山科京を発見する。同じクラスだが彼女に関する知識は少ない。病気がちで欠席が多く、目立たない女子だ。
lines.english: Takashi—I—first encountered Miyako Yamashina on the way to school. She was in my class, though I knew little about her. A quiet girl, often absent due to poor health.

lines.japanese: 次いで針生蔵人に遭遇。年上の同級生。クラスメイトとほとんど接触を持たない彼は、そのとき初めて羽田タカシと言葉を交わした。かのように見えたが──
lines.english: Next came Kurodo Hariu, an older classmate. Though he had almost no contact with the rest of the class, it had seemed that this was the first time he and Takashi Haneda had ever spoken—

lines.japanese: 「──そうじゃなかった。針生蔵人はあの時点で、すでに隼人や伽楼羅を知っていた……ばふん、小賢しい」
lines.english: “—but it wasn't. By then, Kurodo Hariu already knew Hayato and Karura... Bafun. Insolent creature.”

lines.japanese: 俺たちの事情を知る男。厄介なのが同じクラスにいたものだ。いや、ほとんどいないか。年がら年中サボってるからな、あのカラス。
lines.english: A man who knew our circumstances. What a troublesome person to have in my class. Though he was hardly ever actually *in* it. That Crow skipped school all year round.

lines.japanese: 「それから……針生蔵人の鞄を預かって……」
lines.english: “And then... I took Kurodo Hariu's bag...”

lines.japanese: 俺はふたたび羽田タカシの足跡をたどる。
lines.english: I resumed tracing Takashi Haneda's steps.

lines.japanese: 登校した彼は３－Ａ女子学級委員・高内昌子から、卒業文集制作についての話し合いを持ちかけられる……
lines.english: When he arrived, Shoko Takanouchi, the female class representative of 3-A, asked him to discuss production of the graduation anthology...

lines.japanese: 彼女はひどく不遜な態度で僕──俺を嘲笑い……
lines.english: She mocked him—me—with an attitude of appalling insolence...

lines.japanese: 僕は彼女の一方的な言い分に申しわけばかりの抵抗をしたけれど……
lines.english: He made only the barest show of resisting her one-sided demands, but...

lines.japanese: 「待って……この先は……」
lines.english: “Wait... What comes next...”

lines.japanese: 記憶に靄がかかり不鮮明になると同時、頭がにわかに重くなってくる。僕は額に手を添えて俯いた。
lines.english: As mist clouded the memory and robbed it of definition, my head abruptly grew heavy. I bowed my head and pressed a hand to my brow.

lines.japanese: 「きっと……思いださない方がいいんだ……」
lines.english: “I shouldn't... remember this...”

lines.japanese: 光を弾く金色の粒子が、色を失いかけた空間にわずかばかり降りてくる。
lines.english: A scant few golden particles, flashing with reflected light, drifted down through the space as it began to lose its color.

lines.japanese: 「呼んでる……行かなきゃ、グレタガルドへ……」
lines.english: “It's calling me... I have to go to Gretagard...”

lines.japanese: 逃げようと誰かが言う一方で、逃げるなと誰かが言っている。
lines.english: One voice told me to run, while another told me not to.

lines.japanese: 思いだすなと誰かが警告する一方で、勇気を出せと誰かが言っている。
lines.english: One warned me not to remember, while another told me to be brave.

lines.japanese: 勇気を出せ。現実から逃げだすな。俺たちが付いてる。俺たちは無敵だ。いまなら俺たちは飛びだせる。
lines.english: Be brave. Do not flee reality. We are with you. Together, we are invincible. Now we can take wing.

lines.japanese: 昨日までの奈落も、今日からの俺たちならひとっ飛びだ。
lines.english: We could fly straight across even yesterday's Abyss.

lines.japanese: 「うん……そうだね……」
lines.english: “Yes... That's right...”

lines.japanese: 「分かった」
lines.english: “I understand.”

lines.japanese: 僕は──俺はおもてを上げた。
lines.english: I—no, *I*—raised my head.

lines.japanese: 靄が晴れた。いかにも都合よく遮蔽されていたタカシの記憶が剥き出しになり、俺は唇を震わせながら尻ごみした。しかしその傍らで、俺や俺が俺を支えていた。
lines.english: The mist cleared. Takashi's memories, which had been so conveniently screened away, lay naked before me. I shrank back, lips trembling. But there beside me, I and I held me upright.

lines.japanese: そうして俺は、昨日の現実を受けいれることができた。
lines.english: And so I accepted the reality of yesterday.

lines.japanese: 副委員長たちから心ない仕打ちを受けたこと。グレタガルドへ逃げて≪コックピット≫を不在にし、その後の始末を他の人格に任せたこと。その一部始終を渡来明日香に目撃されたこと。
lines.english: The thoughtless cruelty of the assistant representatives. My flight into Gretagard, leaving the *Cockpit* vacant and the aftermath to another personality. And Asuka Watarai witnessing the whole thing.

lines.japanese: 俺の中の誰かが打ちひしがれた。幼いすすり泣きも聞こえた気がする。しかし誰かが言った。
lines.english: Someone inside me was crushed. I thought I heard a child's quiet sobbing. But someone else spoke.

lines.japanese: 「くだらん」
lines.english: “Trifles.”

lines.japanese: くだらぬ茶番だ。何を怖れることがあろうか。胸を張れ、我らは誇り高き血族ぞ。顎を上げよ、見飽きた景色を見降ろしてみよ。
lines.english: A worthless farce. What was there to fear? Stand proud; ours is a noble bloodline. Raise your chin and look down upon this tired scenery.

lines.japanese: 俺が変われば世界も変わる。
lines.english: When I change, the world changes with me.

lines.japanese: 何を怖れることがあろうか。今日からタカシは──俺たちは、もっと胸を張って教室の扉を開けていいんだ。
lines.english: What was there to fear? From today onward, Takashi—we—could open the classroom door with our heads held higher.

lines.japanese: 「さあ行こう。薔薇色の学園生活が俺たちをお待ちだ」
lines.english: “Come. A rose-colored school life awaits us.”

lines.japanese: 「おはよう諸君！」
lines.english: “Good morning, my friends!”

lines.japanese: というわけで、俺は胸を張って教室の扉を開けた。
lines.english: And so I opened the classroom door with my head held high.

lines.japanese: いくつかの目が俺を見てまたすぐ元の方に戻り、いくつかの目は俺を一瞥すらしなかった。
lines.english: Several pairs of eyes looked toward me, then promptly returned to what they had been doing. Several others did not so much as glance my way.

lines.japanese: 「ふうん」
lines.english: “Hmm.”

lines.japanese: 人気ないなあ、羽田君。だから何って話。俺はフッと息を吹きあげ、前髪を揺らしながら席に着いた。
lines.english: Not very popular, are you, Haneda? So what? I took my seat, puffing upward to toss my bangs.

lines.japanese: 山科京と針生蔵人は今日も欠席（あるいは遅刻）のようだ。したがって、いま俺の姿をまじまじと見つめているのはあいつ一人。
lines.english: Miyako Yamashina and Kurodo Hariu appeared to be absent—or late—again today. Thus, only one person was staring openly at me now.

lines.japanese: 人気のない羽田君に、プリンセス渡来明日香だけが露骨な視線を送っていた。
lines.english: Of all the people ignoring unpopular Haneda, only Princess Asuka Watarai made no attempt to hide her stare.

lines.japanese: しかしそれは、とても熱い眼差しと呼ぶには程遠い、ある種の挑発的な薄笑いだった。
lines.english: It was nothing so warm as an ardent gaze, however. What she wore was a faint, provocative smile.

lines.japanese: ちょこざいな。
lines.english: Impertinent creature.

lines.japanese: 彼女には見られたくない場面を見られている。しかも困ったことに、プリンセスは俺たちの秘密になぜだか大変な興味をお寄せになっているのだ。
lines.english: She had seen something I desperately wished she had not. Worse still, the princess had somehow taken an intense interest in our secret.

lines.japanese: 目を合わせないようにして黙々と一時間目の準備をしていたら、案の定むこうから接近してきた。
lines.english: I silently prepared for first period without meeting her eyes. Sure enough, she approached me of her own accord.

lines.japanese: 「おはよー。羽田君？」
lines.english: “Morning, Haneda?”

lines.japanese: 渡来明日香は「おはよー羽田君」ではなく「おはよー（間）羽田君？」と来た。
lines.english: Asuka Watarai did not say, *Morning, Haneda.* She said, *Morning... Haneda?*

lines.japanese: あなたは羽田君ですかそれとも別の誰かさんですか？　という遠回しの誰何。
lines.english: *Are you Haneda, or are you somebody else?* It was an indirect demand that I identify myself.

lines.japanese: やはり一日経ってもプリンセスはいまだお疑いのご様子。指定危険人物ランクＢだ。
lines.english: Even after a full day, the princess evidently remained suspicious. Designated Hazard, Rank B.

lines.japanese: 「どーも」
lines.english: “Hello.”

lines.japanese: 俺は素っ気なく対応した。彼女に悪気はないのかもしれないが、俺たちの事情を知りたがっているような女と面白おかしく歓談するのは危険だ。
lines.english: I answered curtly. She might mean no harm, but making merry conversation with a woman who seemed eager to learn our circumstances would be dangerous.

lines.japanese: 幸か不幸か俺たち五人が互いに混ざりあったせいで、タカシがのぼせていたあの淡い想いも、いまや五分の一に希釈されているようだ。ならばこれ以上親しくなる必要もない。むしろ遠ざけるべきだろう。
lines.english: For better or worse, now that the five of us had blended together, Takashi's feverish little affection had apparently been diluted to one-fifth strength. There was no need to grow any closer to her. On the contrary, I ought to drive her away.

lines.japanese: 学園一の美少女だか何だか知らないが、俺は自らの保身のため、ときには冷徹に振るまわねばならないのだ。ごめんね渡来さん。
lines.english: She might be the most beautiful girl in school or whatever else, but self-preservation sometimes demanded cruelty. Forgive me, Miss Watarai.

lines.japanese: だがプリンセスは立ち去らない。
lines.english: Yet the princess did not leave.

lines.japanese: 見てる。
lines.english: She was watching me.

lines.japanese: まだ見てる。
lines.english: Still watching.

lines.japanese: わざとらしく唸りだした。
lines.english: She made a show of humming thoughtfully.

lines.japanese: 「どーだろうなー」
lines.english: “I wonder...”

lines.japanese: 独り言を始めた。
lines.english: She began talking to herself.

lines.japanese: 「どーだろうねえ？」
lines.english: “What do you think?”

lines.japanese: 独り相談を始めた。
lines.english: She began consulting herself.

lines.japanese: 「だって、ねえ？　羽田君とは雰囲気ちがうでしょー」
lines.english: “I mean, come on. The whole vibe is different from Haneda's, isn't it?”

lines.japanese: 面白いからほっといた。
lines.english: It was entertaining, so I ignored her.

lines.japanese: 「うーん……」
余裕でほっといた。
lines.english: I ignored her without breaking a sweat.

lines.japanese: 「もしもし？　ちょっといい？」
lines.english: “Hello? Got a minute?”

lines.japanese: とうとうプリンセスは放置プレイに根負けして、俺に語りかけてきた。
lines.english: At last, the princess lost her contest with the silent treatment and addressed me directly.

lines.japanese: 「なんだ」
lines.english: “What?”

lines.japanese: すこし気分が良くなったので相手をしてやることにした。ＳはＳを屈伏させることに悦びを覚えるのだ。
lines.english: Now that I felt somewhat better, I decided to grant her my attention. A sadist finds pleasure in bringing another sadist to heel.

lines.japanese: え、俺Ｓなの？
lines.english: Wait. Am I a sadist?

lines.japanese: 「単刀直入に聞くけど」
lines.english: “I'll ask you straight out.”

lines.japanese: 「言ってみろ」
lines.english: “Speak.”

lines.japanese: 命令した。俺は危険度Ｂの渡来明日香に対し、毅然とした態度で接することにしたのだ。
lines.english: It was an order. I had resolved to address Rank B Hazard Asuka Watarai with unflinching authority.

lines.japanese: 「キミ、羽田君じゃないよね」
lines.english: “You're not Haneda, are you?”

lines.japanese: 「いいや、羽田タカシだ」
lines.english: “I am Takashi Haneda.”

lines.japanese: 「ていうかもう、声も口調もぜんぜん羽田君じゃないよね」
lines.english: “I mean, your voice and the way you talk are already nothing like Haneda's.”

lines.japanese: 「イメチェンしたんだよ」
lines.english: “I reinvented myself.”

lines.japanese: 「認めないにしても、せめてもうちょっとマシな嘘をつこうよ」
lines.english: “Even if you won't admit it, you could at least come up with a better lie.”

lines.japanese: 渡来明日香はもっともなことを言った。
lines.english: Asuka Watarai made a reasonable point.

lines.japanese: たしかにそうだ。もっとタカシ的に振るまって「ええ？　なにを言ってるの渡来さん」などと困り顔のひとつでも見せて納得させるべきだった。
lines.english: Indeed, she was right. I ought to have acted more like Takashi—put on a troubled face and said, *What? What are you talking about, Watarai?*—until I convinced her.

lines.japanese: あるいは昨日そうしたように、鷲介風のおどけで有耶無耶にしてしまうか。
lines.english: Or I could have muddied the waters with Shusuke-style clowning, as I had yesterday.

lines.japanese: なのに選りにも選って、隼人や伽楼羅やヨージ的な面が強く出てしまった。
lines.english: Yet of all the possibilities, I had allowed the Hayato, Karura, and Yoji aspects to dominate.

lines.japanese: だが後悔はしていない。
lines.english: I had no regrets.

lines.japanese: なぜなら、俺はＳをおちょくるのが大好きなドＳだからだ。くくく。
lines.english: After all, I was a thoroughgoing sadist who adored tormenting sadists. Heh heh heh.

lines.japanese: 「渡来明日香、今日は何月何日だ」
lines.english: “Asuka Watarai. What is today's date?”
“Today? December... fifth.”

lines.japanese: 「大学デビューとか社会人デビューって言葉があるだろう。俺は１２月５日デビューなんだ。今日から俺様はこのキャラでゴリゴリキメキメぶっちぎっちまうんで今後ともシクヨロぴょん」
lines.english: “You've heard of reinventing yourself in college or at your first job. Well, I'm making my December Fifth Debut. Starting today, this is the character I'm gonna push full-throttle, hard and flashy, straight over the top. Nice ta do biz with ya, bunnykins.”

lines.japanese: 「認めない！」
lines.english: “I refuse to accept it!”

lines.japanese: 「おまえに認めてもらわなくとも一向に構わん。さあ帰れ帰れ」
lines.english: “Your acceptance is of no concern to me. Now off you go. Shoo.”

lines.japanese: 「羽田君はそんな生意気なこと言わない！」
lines.english: “Haneda would never say anything that cocky!”

lines.japanese: 「だまれ駄姫。オレ羽田ガハハ、あーケツ痒いー」
lines.english: “Silence, useless princess. Me Haneda, haw haw. Ahh, my ass itches.”

lines.japanese: 「てめえこのやろ、うちの鷹志を冒涜する気か」
lines.english: “You bastard! How dare you defile my Takashi?”

lines.japanese: 「いっ……ちょ、こら頭を掴むな頭を……！　いで、いでででで！」
lines.english: “Ow! Hey, don't grab my head! Ow, ow ow ow!”

lines.japanese: 「見てろよニセモノ。いまに化けの皮ひんむいて、尻尾つかんでやる」
lines.english: “Just you wait, impostor. I'll tear off that disguise and catch you by the tail.”

lines.japanese: プリンセスはあきらめが悪かった。
lines.english: The princess did not give up easily.

lines.japanese: 皮も尻尾もあるか、事実これが俺なのだから仕方ない。
lines.english: Disguise and tail, indeed. I was simply myself, and there was nothing to be done about it.

lines.japanese: 心に薔薇色のコンタクトレンズを被せた新しい俺。薔薇色の世界を生きる俺。ラビアンローズ俺。
lines.english: The new me, wearing rose-colored contact lenses over the heart. The me who lived in a rose-colored world. La Vie en Rose Me.

lines.japanese: 「なあ渡来明日香、おまえの世界は何色だ」
lines.english: “Tell me, Asuka Watarai. What color is your world?”

lines.japanese: 「んーそうねー、羽田君じゃないくせに気安く話しかけるな色かな」
lines.english: “Hmm, let's see. I'd call it *don't speak so casually when you're not even Haneda* colored.”

lines.japanese: 「ははは、そうか！　俺は友達百人できるかな色だ！　いやはや、生きてるって素晴らしいなあ！」
lines.english: “Ha ha ha! Is that so? Mine is *wonder if I'll make a hundred friends* colored! Ah, what a splendid thing it is to be alive!”

lines.japanese: 素っ裸になって校庭を走りだしたい気分だった。
lines.english: I felt like stripping naked and sprinting onto the athletic field.

lines.japanese: 「というわけで、いいかみんな！　今日は卒業文集制作について話しあうぞ！」
lines.english: “And so, listen well, everyone! Today, we shall discuss production of the graduation anthology!”

lines.japanese: 俺は教卓にてのひらを叩きつけた。
lines.english: I slammed my palm down upon the teacher's desk.

lines.japanese: 昼休みの一部を使った臨時の学級会議。３－Ａ学級委員の羽田鷹志・高内昌子両名は、担任からその議事進行を任されていた。
lines.english: This was a special class meeting held over part of our lunch break. The homeroom teacher had entrusted its proceedings to Takashi Haneda and Shoko Takanouchi, the two representatives of Class 3-A.

lines.japanese: 「委員長ー、早くしないと昼飯食べらンなくなっちゃうでしょー？」
lines.english: “Class rep, if we don't hurry, we're not gonna have time for lunch.”

lines.japanese: 「ッぞウゼーなあ。決めンならとっとと決めて、早く終わらせてくんねーかな」
lines.english: “This is such bullshit. If we're deciding, hurry up and decide so we can get this over with.”

lines.japanese: 「ああ、もちろんそのつもりだ。だから、みんなも早く終わるよう協力してくれ」
lines.english: “Naturally, that is my intention. Therefore, I ask that all of you cooperate in bringing the meeting to an early close.”

lines.japanese: 「へ？　あ、うん……」
lines.english: “Huh? Oh. Sure...”

lines.japanese: 「一切の私語を禁じるほど堅苦しい場にはしたくないが、しかし、そういった行為が少なからず進行の妨げになることも、諸君らは肝に銘じておいてほしい」
lines.english: “I do not wish to make this so rigid an occasion as to forbid all private conversation. But I ask you to bear in mind that such conduct does impede our progress to no small degree.”

lines.japanese: 「あ、はあ、ごめん……」
lines.english: “Oh. Right. Sorry...”

lines.japanese: 「ねえ、ちょっと、なにアレ。羽田のくせに生意気じゃね？」
lines.english: “Hey, what's with him? Haneda's getting awfully full of himself.”

lines.japanese: 「うん……でも今日のあいつ、なんかカンジちがくない？　反論しにくいよね」
lines.english: “Yeah... But doesn't he feel different today? Kinda hard to argue with him.”

lines.japanese: 「たしかに、あの、眼ヂカラ？　妙な威厳ってか、迫力みたいのあるよな」
lines.english: “You're right. It's his eyes, maybe? He's got this weird authority. This intensity.”

lines.japanese: 「ねー、でしょー？　思わずゴメンとか言っちゃったもん私、くっそー」
lines.english: “I know, right? He actually made me apologize. Damn it.”

lines.japanese: 「もうこうなったらアレだな、マチャコに期待だ」
lines.english: “Guess we've gotta put our hopes in Machako now.”

lines.japanese: 「あ、そーじゃん！　チャコなら余裕だよ、ぜったいブッ潰してくれるよ」
lines.english: “Oh, yeah! Chako can handle him. She'll crush him, easy.”

lines.japanese: 教室のあちらこちらで囁かれる、ブランニュー羽田への反響。なんだなんだ、言いたいことがあるなら直接言ってくれればいいのに。ふふん、照れ屋さんたちめ。俺は聞こえないふりをして横を向いた。
lines.english: Reactions to the brand-new Haneda whispered through every corner of the classroom. Now, now. If they had something to say, they could simply say it to my face. Hmph. Shy creatures, all of them. I turned aside and pretended not to hear.

lines.japanese: 「副委員長」
lines.english: “Assistant representative.”

lines.japanese: 「俺は議題を進めておくから、おまえはこれを板書しといてくれ」
lines.english: “I'll move the agenda forward. Write this on the board for me.”

lines.japanese: 教壇の端に脚を組んで座っていた高内昌子へ、ルーズリーフのメモ書きを突きだした。
lines.english: I held out a loose-leaf page of notes to Shoko Takanouchi, who sat on the edge of the teacher's platform with her legs crossed.

lines.japanese: 彼女は静止したままたっぷり５秒ほどタメを作り、やがて脚を組みかえながらゆっくり俺を見上げた。
lines.english: She remained perfectly still, letting a full five seconds of silence build. At last, she switched which leg lay atop the other and slowly looked up at me.

lines.japanese: 「ハァ～ア？」
lines.english: “Huuuh?”

lines.japanese: 左右の眉を段違いにした威嚇スマイル。
lines.english: An intimidating smile, one eyebrow raised far above the other.

lines.japanese: 「ン？　すまん、聞こえなかったか。だから、おまえらが昨日まとめてくれた資料をもとにみんなの役割分担を決めるから、黒板に書きだしてくれと言ったんだ」
lines.english: “Hm? Forgive me, did you not hear? I said I will assign everyone's roles based on the material you assembled yesterday, and asked you to put them on the board.”

lines.japanese: 「え、なに。あんた私に命令してんの」
lines.english: “Wait. Are you ordering me around?”

lines.japanese: 「いや、依頼だよ。頭を下げてお願いしてるんだ。当たり前だろう、同級生同士で命令もクソもあるか」
lines.english: “No. I am making a request. I bow my head and ask it of you. Naturally. Classmates have no authority to command one another.”

lines.japanese: 「天は人の上に人を作らず、学園はクラスメイトの上にクラスメイトを作らず。俺たちはみんな平等だ、この中の誰一人おまえより偉くはないし、逆もまた然り」
lines.english: “Heaven creates no man above another, and the academy creates no classmate above another. We are all equal. Not one person here stands above you, and the reverse is equally true.”

lines.japanese: 「はー。つってっけど、したら羽田、おめーナンダソノ偉ッそうな口のきき方はアァン？」
lines.english: “Huh. That's what you're saying, but then what's with that high-and-mighty way you're talking, Haneda? Huh?”

lines.japanese: 「ははは、それを言ったら、高内さんの方がよっぽど偉そうだと思うぞ。はいコレよろしく」
lines.english: “Ha ha ha. If we're discussing high-and-mighty behavior, I believe yours is far worse, Miss Takanouchi. Here. I'm counting on you.”

lines.japanese: 「ちっ」
lines.english: “Tch.”

lines.japanese: 彼女は鼻息あらく立ちあがると、俺の手からメモを引ったくって黒板と向かいあった。そのあいだに俺は、ぽかんと静まりかえった聴衆へ向きなおる。
lines.english: She surged to her feet with an angry snort, snatched the notes from my hand, and turned to the blackboard. Meanwhile, I faced the audience, which had fallen into stunned silence.

lines.japanese: 「さあ、それではパッパと進めてパッパと終わらせよう。諸君らにも薔薇色の昼休みや、薔薇色の放課後や、薔薇色のあれやこれが待っているだろう」
lines.english: “Now, let us move briskly and finish briskly. Rose-colored lunch breaks, rose-colored afternoons, and all manner of rose-colored delights await you too, I am sure.”

lines.japanese: 「なー。提案なんだけど、先にグループ分けしねえ？　一人っつ決めてくより、その方が効率いいじゃん」
lines.english: “Hey. Suggestion: why don't we split everybody into groups first? It'll be faster than assigning them one at a time.”

lines.japanese: 高内昌子がチョークを持ったまま振りかえった。積極的な意見。素晴らしいじゃないか。
lines.english: Shoko Takanouchi turned around, chalk still in hand. A constructive proposal. Splendid.

lines.japanese: 「マーベラス。いいぞ副委員長、俺たち３Ａはいつだって、おまえのように前向きかつ革新的なオピニオンリーダーの後塵を拝したいと願っていた。さすが。片手で目薬を注せる女は言うことが違うな」
lines.english: “Marvelous. Well done, assistant representative. All of us in 3-A have ever yearned to follow in the wake of a forward-looking, innovative opinion leader such as yourself. As expected. A woman capable of putting in eye drops one-handed truly speaks with distinction.”

lines.japanese: 「よし、聞いたかみんな、まずは班分けだ！」
lines.english: “Right! You heard her, everyone. First, we divide into groups!”

lines.japanese: 「というわけで、おめでとう！　我が羽田班に組みこまれた幸運な班員は君たちだ！」
lines.english: “And with that—congratulations! You are the fortunate members selected for the glorious Haneda Group!”

lines.japanese: 「もうひとりは、きょう欠席の山科京！　そして俺が班長の羽田ヨー……タカシだ。以後シクヨロぴょん！」
lines.english: “Our final member is today's absentee, Miyako Yamashina! And your group leader is Yo—Takashi Haneda. Nice ta do biz with ya, bunnykins!”

lines.japanese: 「おいおいどうしたー、声が小さいじゃないか。念のため言っておくが、俺だっておまえらと同じ班になってしまったことは、とても遺憾なんだぞブッ殺すぞコノヤロウ。元気よく行くぞ、以後シクヨロぴょん！」
lines.english: “Come now, what's the matter? I can barely hear you. For the record, I too am deeply aggrieved to have landed in the same group as you miserable bastards, and I'll fucking kill you, asshole. Let's hear some spirit! Nice ta do biz with ya, bunnykins!”

lines.japanese: 「へーい」
lines.english: “Yaaay.”

lines.japanese: 「ファーック」
lines.english: “Fuuuck.”

lines.japanese: 「よし、いい返事だ！」
lines.english: “Excellent responses!”

lines.japanese: 「でー？　これからどーするの偽物」
lines.english: “Sooo? What do we do now, impostor?”

lines.japanese: 「に、ににに偽物じゃありませんっ」
lines.english: “I-I-I am not an impostor!”

lines.japanese: 「偽物……？　そりゃどういう意味だい陛下」
lines.english: “Impostor...? What's that supposed to mean, Your Majesty?”

lines.japanese: 「へ、陛下などと呼ぶな、奈落の名に懸けて、俺は柳木原の一市民に過ぎん。羽田班の班長がせいぜいだ」
lines.english: “D-do not call me Your Majesty. By the name of the Abyss, I am merely one citizen of Yanagihara. At most, I am the leader of the Haneda Group.”

lines.japanese: 「おまえ、つまんねえなあ。またグレタガルドの王様ぐらいブッ飛んだやつに会いたいもんだよ」
lines.english: “You're boring. I'd like to meet somebody as completely out there as the King of Gretagard again.”

lines.japanese: 「グレタガルド？　なにそれ」
lines.english: “Gretagard? What's that?”

lines.japanese: 「な、ななな何でもありませんっ。こらっ、おい、この駄カラス。余計なこと言うんじゃありません」
lines.english: “N-n-nothing at all! Hey, you useless Crow. Do not speak of things that do not concern you.”

lines.japanese: 「あァ、いまンところは黙ってた方が面白そうだからなァ、とりあえず言わねえけど。その代わり、俺もう帰っていいだろ」
lines.english: “Yeah, keeping quiet looks more entertaining for now, so I won't say anything yet. In exchange, I can go home now, right?”

lines.japanese: 「へ、なんで？　ちょっ、先輩ずるい、そんなの私だって帰りたいよ」
lines.english: “What? Why? That's not fair. If he gets to leave, I want to go home too.”

lines.japanese: 「む、奇遇だな。じつは俺も、今日は早く帰ろうと朝から決めていたのだ」
lines.english: “Hm. What a coincidence. I myself resolved this morning to leave early today.”

lines.japanese: 「はァん、全会一致だねぇ」
lines.english: “Well, that's unanimous.”

lines.japanese: 「班長、決断を」
lines.english: “Group leader, make the call.”

lines.japanese: 「エー、それではですね、今日はひとまず挨拶だけにしてですね、実作業の方はまあ、明日からってことで」
lines.english: “Ahem. In that case, today shall be limited to introductions. Actual work will begin tomorrow.”

lines.japanese: 「異議なし」
lines.english: “No objection.”

lines.japanese: 「右に同じ」
lines.english: “Same here.”

lines.japanese: 「うむ、いい返事だ。では解散」
lines.english: “Good. Excellent responses. Dismissed.”

lines.japanese: 全６コマの授業も昼食戦争も清掃当番も無事に終わり、ようやく訪れた放課後。
lines.english: All six periods, the lunchtime war, and cleaning duty passed without incident, until at last school was over.

lines.japanese: 「ふう」
lines.english: “Whew.”

lines.japanese: 試験運用中の登校初日が、滞りなく終了したわけだ。
lines.english: Thus concluded the first school day of our trial run, without a hitch.

lines.japanese: ま、まあ、多少は滞っていたかもしれないが、誤差の範囲内だろう。
lines.english: W-well, perhaps there had been a hitch or two. But surely they fell within the margin of error.

lines.japanese: 憂慮すべきは内的要因よりむしろ外部からの干渉だな。
lines.english: The greater cause for concern lay in outside interference, rather than internal factors.

lines.japanese: つまり針生蔵人やら渡来明日香やら。
lines.english: In other words, Kurodo Hariu and Asuka Watarai.

lines.japanese: 「しかし当人の発言から推測するに、針生蔵人は当面おとなしくしてそうだ」
lines.english: “Judging from his own remarks, though, Kurodo Hariu intends to behave himself for the time being.”

lines.japanese: 「となると問題は渡来明日香だな……ううむ、アレはもともと何を考えてるやらよく分からん腹黒プリンセスだったから──」
lines.english: “Which makes Asuka Watarai the problem... Hmm. She was always a scheming princess whose thoughts were impossible to read—”

lines.japanese: 「羽田君」
lines.english: “Haneda.”

lines.japanese: 「──ひいっ、ごめんなさい！」
lines.english: “—eep! I'm sorry!”

lines.japanese: 「どうしたの、ぼーっとして。一緒に帰ろ」
lines.english: “What's wrong? You were spacing out. Let's walk home together.”

lines.japanese: 「な、なにっ！　そんな可愛い声を出して、今度はなにを企んでるんだ貴様！」
lines.english: “Wh-what! You put on that adorable voice, but what are you plotting this time?”

lines.japanese: 「……なんだ、偽者か」
lines.english: “...Oh. It's the impostor.”

lines.japanese: 「うるさい、偽者じゃない。この女狐め、何が一緒に帰ろうだ、その手にはのるか。悪いが俺は、おまえのようなうさんくさい女と肩を並べ──」
lines.english: “Silence! I am no impostor. You vixen—what is this *walk home together* business? I shall not fall for your schemes. Regrettably, I have no wish to walk beside a suspicious woman such as—”

lines.japanese: 「ストップ」
lines.english: “Stop.”
“—what?”

lines.japanese: 「ごめん。私、一人で帰りたいから」
lines.english: “Sorry. I'd rather walk home alone.”

lines.japanese: プリンセスは勝手に誘って勝手に去った。
lines.english: The princess had invited me on her own, then gone off on her own.

lines.japanese: 「くっ……こ、これではまるで俺が断られたみたいじゃないか……」
lines.english: “Ngh... Th-this makes it look as though *I* was rejected...”

lines.japanese: なんという屈辱。勝ちほこったような背中を睨んでいると、不意にやつが振りかえった。
lines.english: What humiliation. As I glared at her seemingly triumphant back, she abruptly looked over her shoulder.

lines.japanese: 不敵な微笑み。
lines.english: A fearless smile.
“Hrrn...!”

lines.japanese: なんという負けず嫌いな。
lines.english: What a sore loser.

lines.japanese: なにがプリンセスだ、可愛げのない。あんな生意気な小娘より、素直で無邪気で奥ゆかしいうちの妹の方が億万倍かわゆいというものだ。
lines.english: Some princess. Not one shred of charm. Compared with that impudent brat, my own honest, innocent, modest sister was a billion times more adorable.

lines.japanese: ああ、そうだ、はやく帰って癒されなくては。
lines.english: Yes. I needed to hurry home and let her soothe my soul.

lines.japanese: ああ、早く小鳩に会いたいなあ。
lines.english: I could hardly wait to see Kobato.
